title: INDPRO (Industrial Production: Total Index) — real-time vintage table of 2024 estimates as of 2024-09-17
text:

Source: ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED), series INDPRO. Underlying data: Federal Reserve Board (G.17). Units: index 2017=100, seasonally adjusted.
Revision schedule: first estimate mid-month; revised in each of the following releases.
